|arg= global

|gr1= AI Behaviour

|descr= Returns the behaviour of the individual unit, this is why it only accepts [[Object]] as the argument. For Arma 3 behaviour explanation see [[Arma_3_AI_Behavior]]

|s1= [[behaviour]] unit

|p1= unit: [[Object]]

|r1= [[String]] - one of:
* "CARELESS"
* "SAFE"
* "AWARE"
* "COMBAT"
* "STEALTH"

|x1= <sqf>
